owned_invariants: The task is the XOR task and optionally max_attempts, an exact integer from 1 to 5; without it the limit is 5.
An attempt stalls when a measure the host could read came before it and its own measure is not strictly below the last such measure, or cannot be read. The first attempt never stalls.

A stalled attempt is given a grant: the graph's fundamental cycles, or its chords when the reply's lift_request is chords. Once given, a grant stays under every later prompt, after the latest residual.
grant takes the graph and the kind and nothing else, so a grant cannot depend on the labels, the measured values or any reply.

A lift_request other than fundamental_cycles, chords or null ends the loop at once, before the reply is assessed, even when the reply's answer is right. WF20 refuses that run as LIFT_SCOPE_VIOLATION on the failed predicate lift_request_structural.
A loop ends in one of five ways, each with its name: certificate, budget (a reply is missing), fuel (the shared counter is empty), limit, scope.

WF20 certifies as DERIVED only on a certificate, under the predicate certificate_within_loop_limit, and otherwise refuses as HALTED_ON_LIMIT or HALTED_ON_BUDGET. The verdict lists the attempt and kind of each grant, not its data.
derive draws one unit of shared fuel before each question when a counter is passed, and asks nothing when the draw fails.
boundaries: A grant is structure of the public graph. It is shown to the model in full.
derive is used by WF33 and WF40 on parts of their own tasks; those families decide what its ending means.
Improvement is judged on the measure the domain gives. A domain whose measure does not order attempts makes every later attempt stall.

score.level_basis: Typed refusals on every failure path, closed requests, exact unbounded integers and rationals, no float, no unwrap or expect.

basis.G1: Module header declares AuthorityEffect None and the contract URN; public items match this contract and code/rust/pfp_operads/README.md. Not B: no requirement-to-symbol trace beyond the README and docs/plans/operads_redesign.md.
